property_summary: For any caller and any deposited amount, after calling withdraw the reference C always sets balances(caller) to 0 (clearing the caller's balance); the mutant that sends 0 value may still set balances to 0 but if the external call fails (returns false) the require will revert — however the specific mutant described prevents sending funds and leaves actual ether with contract while still zeroing balances in code-path; to expose difference we assert that after depositing then calling withdraw, address(c).balance decreases by the withdrawn amount (reference: contract transfers funds out; mutant: transferring 0 leaves contract balance unchanged) — the reference always decreases contract balance by the amount withdrawn, the mutant can fail to do so for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the call that sends the full balance with a send of zero value (effectively preventing funds transfer and leaving balances unchanged), so balances remain nonzero after withdraw.
